plan_title: Subpart RR Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification (MRV) Plan Mongoose AGI No. 1 Mitchell County, TX
ama_definition: A half-mile buffer around the modeled plume after 12 years of injection (2036), which also contains the 2041 plume; covers a 12-year period, with a revised plan due by 2036 (p66).
mma_definition: The plume after 40 years of injection plus 120 years of density drift (about 3,280 acres, 3% saturation cutoff) plus a half-mile buffer (p65-66).
leakage_pathways_rated_significant: Only surface equipment is rated 'possible' (during injection); existing wells (two plugged penetrations), faults, the confining layer and seismicity are all rated unlikely with low magnitude (p68).
baseline_summary: Pre-implementation soil gas sampling at the AGI well and one plugged penetration (to be completed by May 20, 2024), atmospheric H2S at the well, a baseline atmospheric CO2 concentration at plant commissioning, and injection volume/pressure baselines once injection starts (p72, p79-80, p83).
reporting_summary: Annual Subpart RR report filed by March 31 of the following year, and annual soil gas results are to be included in it (the p72 wording says only if they indicate an issue); records kept at least three years. No other commitment to publish data (p72, p80, p88, p91).

rows.detail: Volumetric flow meter on the injected stream, compiled quarterly; composition from a continuous analyzer or representative sampling, averaged quarterly; third-party injectate analysis once plant operations stabilize.
rows.location: Injection line at the plant (shown on site plan)
rows.trigger_or_response: Material change in injectate composition: MRV plan updated.
rows.evidence_quote: Flow meters will be continuously operated except for maintenance and calibration.

rows.detail: SCADA continuously records injection volume, pressure and temperature at the well and plant; ESD valves with high/low pressure shutoffs; set points keep pressure below fracture gradient.
rows.location: Mongoose AGI No. 1 and plant surface equipment
rows.trigger_or_response: Data beyond limits or pressure change suggesting fault/seal pathway: alert, field review, shut in if needed; M3.0+ seismic event triggers review of volumes and pressures.
rows.evidence_quote: Bayswater continuously monitors and collects injection volumes, pressures, and temperatures through their SCADA systems, for the Mongoose.

rows.detail: Plan says a change in annular pressure would signal a possible leak, implying annulus pressure is tracked; no gauge or frequency described.
rows.trigger_or_response: Change in injection or annular pressure: thorough investigation.
rows.evidence_quote: A change of injection or annular pressure would indicate the presence of a possible leak and be thoroughly investigated.

rows.detail: MIT every five years under TRRC rule 3.46 to confirm the well and wellhead hold operating pressure.
rows.trigger_or_response: Failed MIT: well isolated and leak mitigated.
rows.evidence_quote: an MIT will be performed every 5 years, as required by the TRRC and UIC.

rows.detail: Routine field inspections of the plant and well, checking gauges and gas monitoring equipment and looking for vapor clouds or ice.
rows.trigger_or_response: Vapor clouds or ice found: corrective action taken.
rows.evidence_quote: field personnel conduct routine visual field inspections of gauges, and gas monitoring equipment.

rows.detail: Fixed ambient H2S monitors at key plant locations and near the well, read continuously by SCADA; high alarm 15 ppm, shutdown 40 ppm. H2S is the proxy for CO2.
rows.location: Plant and near the Mongoose well (site plan, Appendix B-2)
rows.trigger_or_response: High alarm at 15 ppm; facility shutdown at 40 ppm; release quantified from operating conditions.
rows.evidence_quote: Ambient H2S monitors are located at the Plant and near the Mongoose for local alarm and are connected to the SCADA system for continuous monitoring.

rows.detail: Passive soil gas probes left 21 days, then lab-analyzed for CO2, H2S and hydrocarbon trace gases; baseline by May 20, 2024, then yearly.
rows.location: AGI well site and one plugged penetration of the injection interval within the AMA
rows.trigger_or_response: Results indicating an issue are presented in the annual GHGRP report.
rows.evidence_quote: Thereafter, soil gas samples will be taken annually and analyzed by a third-party lab, and the results will be included in the annual report.

rows.detail: Monitoring table lists annual groundwater samples from monitoring wells, but the text says no groundwater wells exist in the MMA, so none will be monitored.
rows.evidence_quote: there are no groundwater wells within the MMA. Therefore, there are no groundwater wells to monitor.

rows.detail: Bayswater's own shallower producing wells used as proxy above-zone monitors: routine gas analysis of produced gas checked for changes in CO2 content against historical data.
rows.location: Bayswater-operated producing wells within the AMA/MMA
rows.trigger_or_response: Material CO2 variance from historical data: identify affected wells, find root cause, adjust reported volumes, quantify any leak.
rows.evidence_quote: These wells will be used as a proxy for an above-zone monitoring well.

rows.detail: Relies on the nearest existing TexNet station, about 3.5 miles west-northwest of the well; no operator-owned station. One-time USGS and TexNet catalog review also cited.
rows.location: TexNet station about 3.5 miles WNW of the well
rows.trigger_or_response: Event of M3.0 or greater: review injection volumes and pressures for signs of leakage; quantify any leak.
rows.evidence_quote: Bayswater plans to use the nearest TexNet seismic monitoring station to monitor the area of the Mongoose well.

rows.detail: Existing 3D seismic interpreted as showing no faults at the Ellenburger level; no repeat seismic.
rows.evidence_quote: No faults were interpreted at the Ellenburger level within the 3D seismic coverage in the area of the Mongoose.

rows.detail: One sentence says a baseline atmospheric CO2 concentration will be set at plant commissioning; no method, location or ongoing CO2 monitoring described.
rows.evidence_quote: A baseline atmospheric CO2 concentration will be established during the commissioning of the Plant.

rows.detail: Corrosion control program checked by periodic inspection of corrosion coupons and the cathodic protection system.
rows.evidence_quote: The effectiveness of the internal and external corrosion control program is monitored through the periodic inspection of the corrosion coupons

rows.detail: Subpart W methods for equipment between meter and wellhead; detected leaks quantified from operating conditions or case-by-case engineering analysis, reservoir modeling and history matching; blowdowns go to flare.
rows.location: Surface equipment between flow meter and wellhead
rows.trigger_or_response: Leak detected: quantified, addressed and documented.
rows.evidence_quote: Calculation methods using equations from Subpart W will be used to calculate CO2emissions due to any surface leakage

notes: Appendices A-D (TRRC permit, operating safety plan, site plan, well list) are listed but not in the text file, so permit conditions and detector locations could not be checked. Groundwater conflicts: Table 13 lists annual groundwater samples, but the text says none of the three database wells exist; coded mentioned_only. Producer gas analysis coded as above_zone_monitoring, not production_monitoring (not EOR). No personal H2S monitors mentioned. The 120-year post-injection monitoring period (p78) is unusually long. Some geology pages are image-only or garbled; the monitoring sections read cleanly.
